# Data Processing Addendum

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") forms part of the Agreement and
applies when Vendor processes personal data on behalf of Customer in
connection with the Services.

## 1. Definitions

Capitalized terms have the meanings given in the GDPR (Regulation (EU)
2016/679) or the Agreement. "Personal Data" refers to personal data as
defined under the GDPR processed by Vendor on Customer's behalf.

### 1.1 Roles

For purposes of this DPA, Customer is the Controller and Vendor is the
Processor.

### 1.2 Categories of Data

Personal data processed under this DPA may include the categories of
data and data subjects described in the applicable order form or as
otherwise instructed by Customer.

## 2. Processing Instructions

Vendor will process Personal Data only on documented instructions from
Customer, including transfers of Personal Data to a third country,
unless required to do so by applicable law.

### 2.1 Lawful Basis

Customer warrants it has a lawful basis for the Processing and has
provided required notices to data subjects.

### 2.2 Sub-Processors

Vendor maintains a current list of authorized Sub-Processors and will
notify Customer of any intended changes, giving Customer the opportunity
to object on reasonable grounds.

## 3. Security

Vendor will implement appropriate technical and organizational measures
designed to protect Personal Data, including the measures set forth in
Annex II.

### 3.1 Breach Notification

Vendor will notify Customer without undue delay (and within seventy-two
hours where feasible) after becoming aware of a Personal Data breach
affecting Customer's data.

## 4. International Transfers

Where Vendor processes Personal Data outside the EEA, the Standard
Contractual Clauses ("SCCs") apply as set forth in Annex III.

## 5. Data Subject Rights

Vendor will assist Customer with responding to data subject requests
through appropriate technical and organizational measures.

## 6. Audit Rights

Customer may audit Vendor's compliance with this DPA no more than once
per twelve-month period, on reasonable notice, subject to Vendor's
security and confidentiality policies.

## 7. Term and Deletion

Upon termination of the Agreement, Vendor will return or delete
Personal Data within sixty (60) days, except as required to retain by
applicable law.
